name: Moon Shard
rules_text: These tokens have effects documented on both sides of the Hero Board. These token may not be removed or transferred by any means except as a result of this Hero's abilities & cards.

name: Bleed
rules_text: Roll 1 [die] in Upkeep Phase. On 1-4, receive 1 dmg, otherwise, remove token: A player afflicted with this token must roll 1 [die] during their Upkeep Phase. On 1-4, they are dealt 1 dmg. On 5-6, remove this token.

name: Prey
rules_text: Add 1 or 2 dmg when Attacking: When a player afflicted with this token is Attacked by an opponent, the Attacker may roll 1 [die]: • On 1, remove this token. • On 2-5, the Attacker increases their dmg by 1. • On 6, the Attacker increases their dmg by 2. Attack Modifier.

name: Scratch
rules_text: [slash] ×3: Deal 4 dmg. [slash] ×4: Deal 5 dmg. [slash] ×5: Deal 6 dmg. On 3-of-a-kind (#'s), inflict Bleed.

name: The Cure
rules_text: Gain Moon Shard and 1 CP. Draw 1. Heal 3.

name: Twilight
activation_requirement: Passive; Upkeep Phase with 3 Moon Shard
rules_text: During your Upkeep Phase, if you have 3 Moon Shard, flip your Hero Board.

name: The Hunt
rules_text: Inflict Prey. Then deal 6 dmg.

name: Conflicted
rules_text: Small Straight: Gain Moon Shard. Deal 6 dmg. Large Straight: Gain 2 Moon Shard. Deal 8 dmg.

name: Ensnare
rules_text: Gain 2 Moon Shard. Inflict 2 Prey. Then deal 5 undefendable dmg.

name: Full Moon
rules_text: Deal 5 dmg & roll 4 [dice]: Add 1 × [slash] dmg. On [crescent], gain 1 CP or Moon Shard. On [full moon], gain 1 CP and Moon Shard.

name: Refresh
rules_text: Heal 1 × [crescent]. On [full moon], gain Moon Shard.

name: Unleash the Beast!
rules_text: Gain 2 Moon Shard. Then flip your Hero Board and activate the Werewolf's Ultimate Ability. ULTIMATE — Dice may be altered to prevent an Ultimate. Otherwise, no action of any kind may be performed by any opponent until the ability fully completes.

rules_text: Slash.

name: Crescent

name: Etiquette!
rules_text: Play only after being Attacked. If an opponent is Attacking you with at least 10 dmg, Heal 2 and gain Moon Shard.

name: Quenched!

name: Scent of Blood!

name: Life Trade!

name: Briar Thorn!
rules_text: Choose an opponent and roll 1 [die]: On [crescent], inflict 2 Bleed. Otherwise, inflict Bleed.

name: Waxing Moon!
rules_text: If Werewolf, roll 1 [die]: On [slash], deal 4 dmg to a chosen opponent. On [crescent], draw 2. On [full moon], gain Moon Shard.

name: Waning Moon!
rules_text: If Pale Lady, roll 1 [die]: On [slash], deal 2 dmg to a chosen opponent. On [crescent], gain 2 CP. On [full moon], Heal 2.

name: Petulant!

rules_text: [slash] ×3: Deal 4 undefendable dmg. [slash] ×4: Deal 5 undefendable dmg. [slash] ×5: Deal 6 undefendable dmg. On 3-of-a-kind (#'s), inflict Bleed.

rules_text: Deal 8 undefendable dmg.

name: Twilight
rules_text: At the conclusion of your turn, remove 1 Moon Shard. Then, if you do not have any Moon Shard, flip your Hero Board.

name: The Hunter
rules_text: Inflict 2 Prey. Then deal 7 dmg.

name: Sunder
rules_text: Small Straight: Inflict Bleed. Deal 8 + 1 dmg per Moon Shard. Large Straight: Inflict 2 Bleed. Deal 8 + 2 dmg per Moon Shard.

name: Jaws of the Wolf
rules_text: Inflict Prey and roll 4 [dice]: On [full moon], gain Moon Shard. Then deal 5 + 2 undefendable dmg per Moon Shard.

name: Full Moon Blitz
rules_text: Heal 1 per Moon Shard. Deal 4 + 1 undefendable dmg per Moon Shard.

name: Backslash
rules_text: Deal 1 × [slash] dmg. On [crescent], inflict Bleed. On [full moon], deal 2 dmg.

name: Unleash the Beast!
rules_text: Gain Moon Shard. Inflict Prey and 2 Bleed. Then deal 13 dmg. At the conclusion of your turn, do not remove 1 Moon Shard. ULTIMATE — Dice may be altered to prevent an Ultimate. Otherwise, no action of any kind may be performed by any opponent until the ability fully completes.

name: Nevermore
rules_text: Nevermore joins the Raveness in battle as an instrument of chaos. When Nevermore is Activated, the Raveness may choose one: • Move Nevermore to a chosen player. • Absorb Vitality. Absorb Vitality: May only be chosen while Nevermore is on an opponent. For each instance of Absorbing, increase Nevermore's dial by 1 (max 3). Then that opponent receives 1 as an isolated source of undefendable dmg. Whenever Nevermore is moved to the Raveness, Heal the amount on Nevermore's dial. Then reduce the dial to zero. If an opponent has Nevermore, they must roll 1 [die] during their Upkeep Phase. This is called the Nevermore Die Roll: • On 1, that opponent gains Hex. • On 2, the Raveness may Activate Nevermore two times. • On 3, the Raveness may Activate Nevermore. • On 4, that opponent discards 1 of their choice. • On 5, that opponent loses 1 CP. The Raveness gains 1 CP. • On 6, reduce Nevermore's dial to 0. Then return Nevermore to the Raveness. HERO SETUP — Begin the game with Nevermore on your Hero Board set to 0.

name: Feather
rules_text: A player with these tokens may spend them at any time to activate a variety of effects: • 1 token: Force the Nevermore Die Roll to be re-rolled. • 2 tokens: Increase or decrease the value of the Nevermore Die Roll by 1. • 3 tokens: Activate Nevermore.

name: Hex
rules_text: 6's are considered blanks: A player afflicted with this token must treat all of their die faces with a 6 as if those faces are completely blank instead. At the conclusion of their turn, remove this token. This token may not be transferred by any means (but can be removed).

name: Craven

name: Fantastic Terrors!
rules_text: Activate Nevermore three times. Inflict Hex. Deal 13 dmg. ULTIMATE — Dice may be altered to prevent an Ultimate. Otherwise, no action of any kind may be performed by any opponent until the ability fully completes.

name: Stone Beak!
rules_text: Play only if Nevermore is on the target of your Attack. Add 1 dmg. This Attack becomes undefendable.

name: Nevermore Attack!

name: Broken Stillness!
rules_text: Activate Nevermore.

name: Midnight Dreary!
rules_text: Roll 5 [dice]: Gain 1 × [wing] Feather. On [raven eye], Activate Nevermore.

name: Talon Strike!
rules_text: Roll 5 [dice]: Add 1 × [talon] dmg.

name: Cull!
rules_text: Change the value of the Nevermore Die Roll. Gain Feather.

rules_text: [talon] ×3: Deal 6 dmg. [talon] ×4: Deal 7 dmg. [talon] ×5: Deal 8 dmg. On 3-of-a-kind (#'s), Activate Nevermore.

rules_text: FOWL FRIEND II — Draw 1. Gain max Feather. Activate Nevermore three times. BIRDS OF A FEATHER — Increase Feather Stack Limit by 1. Then activate FOWL FRIEND II.

name: Raven Sight II
rules_text: Activate Nevermore two times. Deal 3 undefendable dmg.

name: Chamber II / Aviary
rules_text: CHAMBER II — Activate Nevermore three times. Deal 7 undefendable dmg. AVIARY — Gain 4 Feather. Deal 2 undefendable dmg.

name: Beguile II / Pluck
activation_requirement: Beguile II: Large Straight; Pluck: [wing] ×3 + [raven eye] ×2
rules_text: BEGUILE II — Gain 3 Feather. Activate Nevermore two times. Deal 9 dmg. PLUCK — Inflict Hex. Then deal 9 dmg.

rules_text: Deal 1 × [talon] dmg. On [wing] [wing], prevent 2 dmg. On [raven eye] [raven eye], Activate Nevermore.

name: Murder of Crows II
rules_text: Deal 6 dmg & roll 5 [dice]: Add 1 × [talon] dmg. Gain 1 × [wing] Feather. On [raven eye], Activate Nevermore.

name: Potions
rules_text: Whenever you Attach a Potion: • Choose any one Potion and place it on an open Potion Slot within an acceptable Ability. • You may not Attach more Potions (on your entire Hero Board) than the Limit noted for each Potion type. Whenever you activate an Ability, you may spend any number of Potions that are Attached to that Ability. For an Offensive Ability, spend at the end of the Offensive Roll Phase. For a Defensive Ability, spend after resolving the effects of your defense. These tokens may not be transferred by any means (but can be removed).

name: Punchify
rules_text: May only be Attached to an Offensive Ability. When spent, add 2 dmg to your Attack. Attack Modifier.

name: Bolsterate
rules_text: May only be Attached to a Defensive Ability. When spent, prevent 2 incoming dmg.

name: Cleansitude
rules_text: May be Attached to any Ability. When spent, the Alchemist chooses one: Remove 1 status effect from yourself or Heal 1.

name: Toxification
rules_text: May be Attached to any Ability. When spent, inflict Poison on a chosen player.

name: Poison
rules_text: Receive 1 dmg in Upkeep Phase: A player afflicted with this token is dealt 1 dmg per Poison token during their Upkeep Phase. Persistent.

name: Potion Overload
rules_text: Attach 2 Potions. Deal 7 dmg.

name: Diffusion
rules_text: Small Straight: Attach 1 Potion. Deal 7 dmg. Large Straight: Attach 2 Potions. Draw 1. Deal 8 dmg.

rules_text: Attach 1 × [crucible] Potion.

rules_text: Attach 4 Potions. Deal 10 dmg. You may spend up to 3 Potions that are Attached to your Offensive Abilities. ULTIMATE — Dice may be altered to prevent an Ultimate. Otherwise, no action of any kind may be performed by any opponent until the ability fully completes.

rules_text: Remove up to 2 Attached Potions. Then gain 2 CP per Potion removed.

rules_text: Remove Punchify to deal 3 dmg to a chosen player.

name: Transmogrify!
rules_text: Remove Cleansitude to remove a status effect token from a chosen player.

name: Concoction!
rules_text: Roll 1 [die]: On [solution], Attach 1 Potion. On [composition], Attach 2 Potions of the same type. On [crucible], Attach 2 Potions and Heal 1.

name: Potion Master!
rules_text: Attach 1 of each type of Potion.

name: Noxious!
rules_text: Attach Toxification.

name: Potion Explosion!

name: Life Extraction!
rules_text: Roll 3 [dice]: Add 1 × [solution] dmg. Heal 1 × [solution].

name: Girded!
rules_text: You may perform an additional Roll Attempt of up to five dice during the Defensive Roll Phase. If you do not roll any [crucible] with your defense, prevent 2 incoming dmg.

name: Chain Reaction II
rules_text: Deal 7 dmg. You may spend 1 Potion that is Attached to your other Offensive Abilities.

name: Hermetics II / Inspired Chemist
rules_text: HERMETICS II — Attach 3 Potions. Heal 3. INSPIRED CHEMIST — Attach 4 Potions. Heal 4.

name: The Lab II
rules_text: During your Upkeep Phase, roll 1 [die]: On [solution], Attach 1 Potion. On [composition] or [crucible], Attach 2 Potions. You may remove an Attached Potion at any time to re-roll 1 of your dice.

name: Potion Overload II
rules_text: Attach 3 Potions. Deal 7 dmg.

name: Transmute II
rules_text: Gain 2 CP. Deal 6 dmg.

name: Haunted Head
rules_text: Use your Pumpkin Head to frighten an opponent! At the conclusion of your turn, if an opponent has the Haunted Head, gain Dreadful. Terrorize an opponent: You may Terrorize an opponent during your Upkeep Phase when you have at least four Dreadful tokens (reference your Passive Ability, HEADLESS MAYHEM). When an opponent is Terrorized: • Remove four Dreadful tokens. • Move the Haunted Head to your Hero Board (if it is not already there). • Deal 3 as an isolated source of undefendable dmg to a chosen opponent. • Gain Grim Pursuit and 1 CP. HERO SETUP — Begin the game with the Haunted Head on your Hero Board. If you are not the first player to begin the game, gain Dreadful.

name: Dreadful
rules_text: Boost various abilities: These tokens affect various abilities, including when you can Terrorize an opponent.

name: Grim Pursuit
rules_text: Increase Attack dmg or gain Roll Attempt: A player with this token may spend it to activate one of the following effects: • Perform an additional Roll Attempt during your Offensive Roll Phase. • After Attacking, roll 5 [dice]: add 1 × [horseshoe] dmg. Attack Modifier. Each effect may only be activated once per turn.

name: Headless Mayhem

name: Ride Down
rules_text: Gain 2 Grim Pursuit. Then deal 6 dmg.

rules_text: Small Straight: Gain Dreadful. Deal 7 dmg. Large Straight: Gain 2 Dreadful. Deal 9 dmg.

name: Horrify
rules_text: Choose one: Gain 3 Dreadful; or gain Grim Pursuit. If you have the Haunted Head, do both instead. Then deal 6 undefendable dmg.

name: Spectral Assault
rules_text: Gain Dreadful. Then deal 8 dmg and roll 1 [die] per Dreadful (up to 5 [dice] total): Add 1 × [axe] dmg. On [horseshoe] [horseshoe], this Attack becomes undefendable. Gain 1 × [scare] Grim Pursuit.

name: Hallowed Reckoning
rules_text: Roll 1 [die] plus 1 more for each Dreadful (up to 5 [dice] total): Deal 1 × [axe] dmg. For every [horseshoe] [horseshoe], prevent 1 dmg. Gain 1 × [scare] Dreadful.

name: Dreadful Charge!
rules_text: Gain 4 Dreadful. Deal 14 dmg. ULTIMATE — Dice may be altered to prevent an Ultimate. Otherwise, no action of any kind may be performed by any opponent until the ability fully completes.

name: Sow Despair II
rules_text: Small Straight: Gain 2 Dreadful. Deal 7 dmg. Large Straight: Gain 3 Dreadful. Deal 10 dmg.

name: Reap II / The Reaper
rules_text: REAP II — Gain 2 Dreadful. Deal 4 undefendable dmg. If you have the Haunted Head, draw 1. THE REAPER — Draw 1. Gain 3 Dreadful. Deal 4 undefendable dmg.

name: Cleave II / Ghostly Charge
rules_text: CLEAVE II — [axe] ×3: Deal 5 dmg. [axe] ×4: Deal 6 dmg. [axe] ×5: Deal 8 dmg. On 3-of-a-kind (#'s), gain Dreadful. GHOSTLY CHARGE — Gain 2 Grim Pursuit. Deal 2 pure dmg.

name: Hallowed Reckoning II
rules_text: Roll 2 [dice] plus 1 more for each Dreadful (up to 5 [dice] total): Deal 1 × [axe] dmg. For every [horseshoe] [horseshoe], prevent 1 dmg. Gain 1 × [scare] Dreadful. On [scare] [scare], gain Grim Pursuit.

rules_text: HORRIFY II — Gain 3 Dreadful and 2 Grim Pursuit. Then deal 6 undefendable dmg. SPOOKY — Gain 2 Grim Pursuit. Then deal 7 dmg.

rules_text: SPECTRAL ASSAULT II — Gain Dreadful. Then deal 9 dmg and roll 1 [die] per Dreadful (up to 5 [dice] total): Add 1 × [axe] dmg. On [horseshoe] [horseshoe], this Attack becomes undefendable. Gain 1 × [scare] Grim Pursuit. HAUNTED STRIKE — Deal 4 undefendable dmg.

name: Ride Down II / Cursed Gallop
rules_text: RIDE DOWN II — Gain 3 Grim Pursuit. Then deal 6 dmg. CURSED GALLOP — Gain Grim Pursuit. Then deal 1 undefendable dmg.

name: Dark Surprise!
rules_text: Gain 2 Dreadful.

name: Cranial Assist!
rules_text: If your opponent has the Haunted Head, add 3 dmg.

name: Dancing Pumpkin!
rules_text: If you have the Haunted Head, gain 2 Dreadful. Otherwise, gain 2 Grim Pursuit.

name: Spirited Reprisal!
rules_text: Play only after being Attacked. If you have the Haunted Head, prevent 3 incoming dmg.

name: Rolling Pumpkin!
rules_text: Move the Haunted Head to a chosen player.

name: Thundering Hooves!
rules_text: Spend up to 3 CP. Then gain 1 Grim Pursuit per CP spent.

name: Undead
rules_text: Summoning Undead: • Undead are Summoned by spending Corpses during your Main Phase. • Whenever an Undead is Summoned, place it on your Hero Board. • You cannot Summon more Undead than the Limits noted below. Activating Undead: • Each Summoned Undead has an ability that can be activated once per turn. • At the conclusion of your Roll Phase, roll 1 [die] for each Undead that was activated; roll all of these dice simultaneously. For every [bones] rolled, remove one Undead of your choosing.

name: Skeletal Warrior
rules_text: Bone Spear: Add 1 dmg. Attack Modifier.

name: Skeletal Mage
rules_text: Only one of these abilities may be activated per turn: • Withering: Inflict Decrep-ify. Attack Modifier. • Scything Touch: Steal 1 Health; can only be used if you activated 3 Skeletal Warriors this turn. Attack Modifier.

name: Bone Golem
rules_text: Bone Spur: Add 2 dmg. Attack Modifier. Bone Spikes: When being Attacked, remove Bone Golem to deal 2 dmg and prevent 2 dmg without rolling a die for activating the ability.

name: Corpse
rules_text: Corpses are a unique resource that may be spent for a variety of effects during your Main Phase: • 2 Corpses: Summon Skeletal Warrior. • 3 Corpses: Summon Skeletal Mage. • 6 Corpses: Summon Bone Golem. • 10 Corpses: Gain Resurrect.

name: Unearth
rules_text: During your Upkeep Phase, you must move this card to cover a different Offensive Ability on your Hero Board. After moving this card, gain the number of Corpses noted in the upper-right corner of the covered Ability. While an ability is covered, it cannot be activated. HERO SETUP — Cover your Black Shroud ability with your Unearth card. Set your Corpse Dial to 0.

name: Decrep-ify
rules_text: Roll Attempts and Attacks become weaker: During their next Offensive Roll Phase, a player afflicted with this token may only re-roll a maximum of 2 dice when performing any Roll Attempt after their first Roll Attempt. Additionally, reduce any Attack dmg by 1. Attack Modifier. At the conclusion of the Roll Phase, remove this token.

name: Resurrect
rules_text: Instead of being defeated, become a lifeless husk of your former self: The next time a player or team with this token would have their health reduced to 0, instead remove this token and set their health to 5. That player or team can no longer gain or spend CP. Additionally, if that player or team has any cards, they must discard them all and can no longer draw cards for the remainder of the game. This token may not be removed or transferred by any other means.

rules_text: Deal 4 dmg and spend up to 3 Corpses to roll 1 [die] for each Corpse spent: Add 1 × [scythe] dmg. Add 2 × [bones] dmg. On [soul], this Attack becomes undefendable.

rules_text: Deal 6 dmg. You do not have to roll [dice] for any Undead activated this turn.

name: Resist Death
rules_text: Gain 1 × [bones] Corpses. On [soul], Steal 1 Health.

name: Necro-Dancer!
rules_text: Gain Resurrect. Inflict Decrep-ify. Then deal 10 dmg. You do not have to roll [dice] for any Undead activated this turn. ULTIMATE — Dice may be altered to prevent an Ultimate. Otherwise, no action of any kind may be performed by any opponent until the ability fully completes.

name: Death Manual!
rules_text: Summon up to two Skeletal Warriors.

name: Go Go Golem!
rules_text: Summon Bone Golem.

name: Bone Appétit!
rules_text: Roll 1 [die]: On [scythe], gain 2 Corpses. On [bones], draw 2. On [soul], inflict Decrep-ify and Steal 1 Health from a chosen opponent.

name: Sturdy Bones!
rules_text: Play only after rolling dice for each Undead that was activated. You may re-roll up to three dice; they can be the same die or different dice in any order.

name: Bone Armor!

name: Fractured Magic!
rules_text: Summon Skeletal Mage.

name: Resist Death II
rules_text: Gain 1 × [bones] Corpses. Steal 1 Health per [soul] rolled.

rules_text: CORPSE EXPLOSION II — Deal 4 dmg and spend up to 4 Corpses to roll 1 [die] for each Corpse spent: Add 1 × [scythe] dmg. Add 2 × [bones] dmg. On [soul], this Attack becomes undefendable. DISENTOMB — Gain 2 Corpses. Then activate CORPSE EXPLOSION II.

name: Harvest II
rules_text: Gain 1 Corpse and roll 1 [die]: On [scythe], deal 5 dmg. On [bones], gain 4 Corpses and draw 1. On [soul], gain 1 Corpse. Then immediately begin an additional Offensive Roll Phase.

rules_text: Spend to re-roll or change one of your dice to a 6: A player with this token may spend 1 to re-roll 1 of their dice, or spend 3 to change any one of their dice to a 6.

name: Egg Nog
rules_text: Spend 3 for a benefit: A player may spend 3 of these tokens at any time to roll 1 [die]. On [axe], deal 2 dmg to a chosen opponent as an isolated source of undefendable dmg. On [bell], Heal 2 and gain 1 CP. On [star], Heal 2 and draw 1 card.

name: Trim Your Tree
rules_text: [axe] ×3: Deal 4 dmg. [axe] ×4: Deal 6 dmg. [axe] ×5: Deal 8 dmg.

name: Festivities
rules_text: Gain 2 Egg Nog. All players gain 1 CP. Then deal 7 dmg plus 1 dmg per player.

name: Fireside Chat
rules_text: After targeting an opponent, roll 1 [die]. If your roll is equal to or greater than 6, deal 6 undefendable dmg and gain Cheer. Otherwise, deal 8 dmg and gain Egg Nog.

name: Naughty or Nice
rules_text: After targeting an opponent, roll 1 [die]. On 1–4, your opponent is nice: They gain 1 CP, then deal 10 dmg. On 5–6, your opponent is naughty: They gain Cheer, then deal 12 dmg.

name: Rosey Cheeks
rules_text: Gain Cheer. Then deal 6 dmg plus 1 dmg per Cheer.

name: Holly Jolly
rules_text: Gain 2 Cheer and 3 Egg Nog. Deal 6 undefendable dmg.

name: Reindeer Games
rules_text: Gain Cheer and 2 Egg Nog. Then deal 4 dmg plus 1 dmg per Egg Nog plus 1 dmg per Cheer.

name: Egg Noggin' It
rules_text: Gain 1 × [bell] Egg Nog. On [star], gain Cheer.

name: Comfort and Joy!
rules_text: Gain 4 Egg Nog. Deal 10 dmg. Immediately target the same opponent with an additional Offensive Roll Phase. ULTIMATE — Dice may be altered to prevent an Ultimate. Otherwise, no action of any kind may be performed by any opponent until the ability fully completes.

rules_text: Axe.

name: Bell

name: Extremely Naughty!
rules_text: Play only after activating your Naughty or Nice Offensive Ability. If your opponent is naughty, this Attack becomes undefendable. Additionally, your opponent must apologize to you for being naughty or else receive 2 more dmg.

name: Nogtastic!
rules_text: Gain 5 Egg Nog.

name: Santa's Helper!
rules_text: Discard 5 Egg Nog to Heal 2, draw 1 card, gain Cheer, and deal 2 dmg to a chosen opponent as an isolated source of undefendable dmg.

name: Rebel Without a Claus!

name: Holly Jolly II / Tannenboom
rules_text: HOLLY JOLLY II — Gain 3 Cheer and 3 Egg Nog. Deal 7 undefendable dmg. TANNENBOOM — Gain Cheer and 5 Egg Nog.

name: Rosey Cheeks II
rules_text: Gain Cheer and Egg Nog. Then deal 7 dmg plus 1 dmg per Cheer.

name: White Elephant Gift!
rules_text: Conceal Cheer and 3 Egg Nog in one hand and nothing in your other hand. Your opponent chooses a hand (or rolls a die to determine if preferred). If they choose the empty hand, you keep the contents of the other. Otherwise, nothing happens.

name: Reindeer Games II / Mistletoe
activation_requirement: Reindeer Games II: Large Straight; Mistletoe: [axe] ×2 + [bell] ×2
rules_text: REINDEER GAMES II — Gain Cheer and 2 Egg Nog. Then deal 4 dmg plus 1 dmg per Egg Nog plus 2 dmg per Cheer. MISTLETOE — Two chosen players gain Cheer (may choose the same player twice). Deal 2 undefendable dmg.

name: Ho, Ho, Ho!
rules_text: Roll 1 [die]. Gain half the value as Cheer (rounded up).

name: Naughty or Nice II
rules_text: After targeting an opponent, roll 1 [die]. On 1–3, your opponent is nice: They gain 1 CP, then deal 11 dmg. On 4–6, your opponent is naughty: They gain Cheer, then deal 13 dmg.

name: Rude-olph!
rules_text: Add 1 dmg per Cheer.

name: Gang-Deer!
rules_text: Roll 5 [dice]. Add 1 × [axe] dmg. On [bell] ×2, gain Cheer.

name: Retribution
rules_text: Spend when Attacked to deal half dmg back: This token may be spent after being Attacked as a result of an opponent’s Offensive Roll Phase to deal half of the incoming dmg (rounded up) back to the Attacker.

name: Crit
rules_text: Spend to add 4 dmg to your Attack: If a player with this token is dealing at least 5 dmg as a result of their Offensive Roll Phase, this token may be spent to deal 4 dmg. Attack Modifier.

name: Protect
rules_text: Prevent half incoming damage: A player with this token may spend it at any time to prevent half incoming damage (rounded up).

name: Accuracy
rules_text: Spend to make your Attack undefendable: A player with this token may spend it at the conclusion of their Offensive Roll Phase to make their Attack undefendable. Attack Modifier.

name: Blessing of Divinity
rules_text: Prevent being defeated: The next time a player (or team) with this token would have their health reduced to 0, remove this token and set their health to 1 instead. This token may not be removed or transferred by any other means.

name: Tithe
rules_text: You may re-roll 1 of your dice at any time for 1 CP per re-roll. You may draw 1 at any time for 3 CP per card.

name: Retaliate
rules_text: A chosen player gains Retribution. Gain 3 CP.

name: Righteous Combat
rules_text: Deal 5 dmg and roll 2 [dice]: Add 1 × [helmet] plus 2 × [sword] dmg. Heal 2 × [life]. Gain 1 CP × [prayer].

name: Mighty Prayer
rules_text: Deal 3 undefendable dmg. Then gain Crit and Accuracy.

name: Holy Attack
rules_text: SMALL STRAIGHT — Heal 1. Deal 6 dmg. LARGE STRAIGHT — Heal 2. Deal 8 dmg.

name: Righteous Prayer
rules_text: Deal 8 dmg. Then gain Crit and 2 CP.

name: Holy Light
rules_text: Heal 1 × [life] and roll 2 [dice]: On [sword], gain Crit. On [helmet], gain Protect. On [life], draw 1. On [prayer], gain 2 CP.

name: Divine Defense
rules_text: On [sword], deal 1 dmg. Prevent 1 × [helmet] plus 2 × [life] dmg. Gain 1 CP × [prayer].

name: Resolute Faith!
rules_text: Gain Blessing of Divinity. Heal 5. Deal 10 dmg. ULTIMATE — Dice may be altered to prevent an Ultimate. Otherwise, no action of any kind may be performed by any opponent until the ability fully completes.

name: Holy Light II
rules_text: Heal 1 × [life] and roll 3 [dice]: On [sword], gain Crit. On [helmet], gain Protect. Draw 1 × [life]. Gain 2 CP × [prayer].

name: Tithe II
rules_text: PASSIVE — You may re-roll 1 of your dice at any time for 1 CP per re-roll. You may draw 1 at any time for 2 CP per card. Whenever you successfully activate an ability during your Offensive Roll Phase that utilizes at least 1 [prayer], gain 1 CP.

name: Consecration!
rules_text: A chosen player gains Protect, Retribution, Crit, and Accuracy.

name: Retaliate II / Requital
rules_text: RETALIATE II — A chosen player gains Retribution. Gain 4 CP. REQUITAL — Gain Retribution. Heal 1. Deal 3 undefendable dmg.

name: Divine Favor!
rules_text: PROMO CARD — Roll 1 [die]: On [prayer], gain 4 CP. On any other outcome, draw 1.

name: Righteous Combat II
rules_text: Deal 5 dmg and roll 3 [dice]: Add 1 × [helmet] plus 2 × [sword] dmg. Heal 2 × [life]. Gain 1 CP × [prayer].

name: Righteous Prayer II / Prosperity
rules_text: RIGHTEOUS PRAYER II — Deal 8 undefendable dmg. Then gain Crit and 2 CP. PROSPERITY — Gain 4 CP.

name: Absolution!
rules_text: Play only after being Attacked. Roll 1 [die]: On [sword], deal 3 dmg. On [helmet], prevent 3 dmg. On [life], prevent 5 dmg. On [prayer], prevent 2 dmg and gain 2 CP.

name: Divine Defense III
rules_text: Deal 1 × [sword] dmg. Prevent 1 × [helmet] plus 2 × [life] dmg. Gain 1 CP × [prayer]. On [helmet] ×2 plus [prayer], gain Protect.

name: Mighty Prayer II / Offensive Stance
rules_text: MIGHTY PRAYER II — Deal 4 undefendable dmg. Then gain Crit and Accuracy. OFFENSIVE STANCE — Deal 2 undefendable dmg. Then gain Crit or Accuracy.

name: Blessed!
rules_text: Roll 1 [die]: On [sword], draw 2. On [helmet], Heal 3. On [life], Heal 4. On [prayer], gain 3 CP.

name: Mighty!
rules_text: A chosen player gains Crit.

name: Chi
rules_text: A player may spend these tokens to increase or reduce dmg: Chi tokens may be spent at any time to prevent 1 incoming damage per token. Alternatively, you may spend Chi to increase Attack dmg by 1 per token spent. Chi may not be used to increase dmg the turn that it was gained. Attack Modifier.

name: Evasive
rules_text: Spend and roll 1–2 to avoid damage: When a player with this token receives damage, they may choose to spend it. If spent, roll 1 [die]. If the outcome is 1–2, no dmg is received (although other associated effects may still apply). Multiple tokens may be spent in an attempt to prevent the same source of damage.

name: Knockdown
rules_text: Spend 2 CP or skip Offensive Roll Phase: To remove this token, a player afflicted with it must spend 2 CP before the start of their Offensive Roll Phase. If the player does not, they must skip their Offensive Roll Phase and then remove this token.

name: Cleanse
rules_text: Spend to remove a status effect token: A player with this token may spend it at any time to remove a single status effect token from themselves.

name: Fist Strike
rules_text: [fist] ×3: Deal 6 dmg. [fist] ×4: Deal 7 dmg. [fist] ×5: Deal 8 dmg.

name: Meditate
rules_text: Gain 5 Chi. Gain Evasive or gain Cleanse.

name: Combo Strike
rules_text: Deal 6 dmg and roll 1 [die]: On [fist], add 2 dmg. On [palm], add 3 dmg. On [zen], gain 2 Chi. On [lotus], gain Evasive or gain Cleanse.

name: Tempest Rush
rules_text: Roll 3 [dice]. Deal dmg equal to the total roll value. If the roll value is at least 13, inflict Knockdown.

rules_text: Deal 5 undefendable dmg. Then increase Chi stack limit by 1 and gain 5 Chi.

rules_text: Roll 3 [dice]. Deal dmg equal to the total roll value. You may spend 1 Chi to re-roll any one of these dice. If the roll value is at least 12, inflict Knockdown.

rules_text: [fist] ×3: Deal 7 dmg. [fist] ×4: Deal 8 dmg. [fist] ×5: Deal 9 dmg.

rules_text: FIST OF TRANQUILITY II — Deal 7 dmg. Then gain Evasive and 3 Chi. Inflict Knockdown. WAY OF THE MONK — Gain 2 Evasive. Deal 3 undefendable dmg.

rules_text: [fist] ×3: Deal 7 dmg. [fist] ×4: Deal 8 dmg. [fist] ×5: Deal 9 dmg. On 4-of-a-kind, inflict Knockdown.

rules_text: Deal 6 dmg. Then gain 3 Chi.

name: Serenity III
rules_text: Gain 1 × [zen] Chi. Deal 1 × [fist] dmg. On [zen] plus [lotus], gain Evasive or gain Cleanse.

name: Combo Strike II
rules_text: Deal 5 dmg and roll 2 [dice]: Add 2 × [fist] dmg. Add 3 × [palm] dmg. Gain 2 × [zen] Chi. For each [lotus], gain Evasive or gain Cleanse.
